title: Verify: Docs name devion workseed, match the export keys and avoid removed terms
summary: Add a Go unit test that reads the docs and checks content against the Export type
description: Add a test that reads backend/README.md and backend/docs/handoff.md from the temp-free repo files and asserts content. No network or processes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the README, when read, then it contains 'devion workseed'
Given the handoff doc, when read, then it contains every JSON key of Export and ExportContribution as encoded by json.Marshal
Given both docs, when lowercased, then they contain none of 'worker', 'executionpanel', 'claude code', 'cursor'
technical_constraints: Unit test only; read files with os.ReadFile relative to the package directory (../../README.md and ../../docs/handoff.md)

steps.action: Add package contribution tests. TestHandoffDocs_ReadmeNamesWorkseed: read ../../README.md, assert it contains 'devion workseed'. TestHandoffDocs_KeysMatchExport: json.Marshal an Export holding one ExportContribution, unmarshal into map[string]any, collect the top-level keys and the keys of contributions[0], and assert handoff.md contains each. TestHandoffDocs_NoRemovedTerms: for both docs, assert the lowercased text contains none of 'worker', 'executionpanel', 'claude code', 'cursor'.
